title: Dragon and Spellforce Wagon
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a large blue dragon with white wings flying while pulling a red wagon labeled 'SPELLFORCE PLAYER' that carries a glowing purple house. To the right, a green feline creature stands on a cracked stone cliff face shaped like a giant head with a mustache, as a waterfall pours from its mouth into a swirling pool below. A swirling vortex of pink and purple petals surrounds the dragon against a dramatic sky with a glowing orange sun.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a majestic blue dragon with white wings flying and pulling a red wooden wagon labeled SPELLFORCE PLAYER that carries a glowing purple house on its back.
